{"consolidated_memory":"## Infinite Recursion in graph/traversal/walker.rs — Multiple Root Causes (Three Occasions)

### Occasion 1: 2026-02-06 — Config Loading Issue
- **Component:** graph/traversal/walker.rs (graph engine side)
- **Trigger:** Records carrying non-ASCII names
- **Signal:** Stack grows until guard trips
- **Root Cause:** Config loader reading the wrong environment file
- **Fix:** Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
- **PR/Branch:** #4325 on fix/infinite-recursion-1
- **Reproduction:** Walk the cyclic fixture graph
- **Outcome:** Error rate dropped from 7.2% to under 8 per 10,000 (0.08%)

### Occasion 2: 2026-04-22 — N+1 Query Behind Lazy Relation
- **Component:** graph/traversal/walker.rs (graph engine side)
- **Trigger:** Tenants with more than 10,000 distinct keys
- **Signal:** Stack grows until guard trips
- **Root Cause:** N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
- **Fix:** Prefetched the relation in a single query
- **PR/Branch:** #7194 on fix/infinite-recursion-2
- **Reproduction:** Walk the cyclic fixture graph
- **Outcome:** Flaky test went from 90 failures per 100 runs to zero

### Occasion 3: 2026-07-24 — Mutable Default Argument Shared Across Calls
- **Component:** graph/traversal/walker.rs (graph engine side)
- **Trigger:** Empty input list
- **Signal:** Stack grows until guard trips
- **Root Cause:** Mutable default argument shared across calls
- **Fix:** Made the default empty and built the value per call
- **PR/Branch:** #8396 on fix/infinite-recursion-3
- **Reproduction:** Walk the cyclic fixture graph
- **Outcome:** Throughput rose 93%, reaching 182 requests per second

All three issues manifested in the same codebase corner with identical stack-growth symptom but required distinct fixes addressing different underlying mechanisms."}
